purpose: Evaluate the single V153-qualified exact-Random-prefix, service-safe Nash mechanism on the complete retained middle-load E01-E20 training block while reusing all frozen baselines and retaining every candidate run.

v153_qualification.interpretation: V153 establishes exact frozen-Random reproducibility on the two diagnostic seeds; it does not establish a Nash improvement or authorize a paper claim.

training_design.technical_retry_rule: Only the frozen same-cell protocol retry policy may retry a technical failure; every failed attempt remains archived.

selection_rule.mean_gate: For each primary metric, the V154 candidate mean must be strictly greater than the maximum mean among all nine frozen non-NSESche middle-load baselines.
selection_rule.paired_gate: For each primary metric, candidate minus frozen FaaSRank must be strictly positive on at least 12 of 20 paired seeds. Finite-only QPR additionally requires finite candidate QPR on all 20 seeds; zero-completed-as-zero retains all 20.
selection_rule.mechanism_gate: At least one nonempty scheduling window must accept a complete Nash proposal under the frozen nonworse-welfare, nonworse-max-service, strictly-lower-sum certificate, and at least one candidate run must differ from its exact frozen Random anchor in a primary metric.
selection_rule.joint_training_pass: All three mean gates, all three paired gates, finite-QPR coverage, and the mechanism gate pass.
selection_rule.zero_completion: Retain the run; finite-only QPR is unavailable and zero-completed-as-zero QPR is zero; never impute or replace a seed.
selection_rule.failure: Retain the complete V154 block, report the negative result, and retire the V154 profile without confirmation inputs or threshold tuning.

before_reveal: exact middle E01-E20 product in the committed order
exact frozen profile, environment, binary, tapes, common HPA, and policy-independent references
all QC-passing canonicals retained with valid ledger and pairing
exact persistent Random shadow invoked once per scheduling window
empty windows use the exact null/invalid/no-proposal certificate
nonempty windows use a valid Random anchor and exact emitted prefix cohort
accepted proposals satisfy complete same-cohort service and welfare certificates
zero throughput, completion, latency, cost, QPR, or aggregate runtime breadth fields parsed before the blind audit is sealed
